title: Personal Agent — Builder Skill Trigger
description: Declarative activation condition for a builder skill. A trigger says WHEN a skill fires and WHAT it produces, mapped onto a host hook (Claude Code hooks / OpenCrab crab_orchestration entry conditions / cron). The cardinal rule: a trigger fires DETECTION/STAGING only; promotion to a confirmed runtime-active record stays gated (requires_confirmation) unless an explicit auto_confirm_policy permits it for narrow high-confidence, non-sensitive cases. Spec: spec/09-triggers.md. Skills own their trigger; crab_orchestration aggregates them into a routing table.

trigger_id.description: Stable id, format pab.<skill>.<on_signal> e.g. pab.diff_mining.on_correction

signal.description: The observable event/condition that fires the trigger.

condition.description: Human-readable predicate refining the signal (e.g. 'agent output edited or rejected by user').

cadence.description: How often / on what rhythm the trigger evaluates.

host_hook.description: Where the trigger binds in the host runtime. Claude Code hook events, an OpenCrab crab_orchestration entry condition, cron, or a slash command. SessionStart=compile; UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse=ambient capture; PreToolUse=pre-action boundary; Stop=session-end mining + review board.

produces.description: The lifecycle stage output this trigger creates. NOTE: capture/mine/extract/scope/route produce STAGED artifacts (pending); only confirmation_gate produces a confirmed/runtime-active record (or auto_confirm_policy does, narrowly).

requires_confirmation.description: If true, the produced artifact cannot become a runtime-active record without explicit human review (Gate G3). Detection/staging triggers set false (they only stage pending items); the confirmation_gate and any boundary/decision-affecting promotion set true.

default_state.description: Privacy-conservative default. enabled=on out of the box; suggested=proposed to the user, off until accepted; off=opt-in only. Sensitive/high-stakes skills default to suggested or off.

stages_to.description: Optional pack visibility for staged output: 'draft' (OpenCrab draft pack) or 'pending' (in-session queue). Promotion changes this to the live instance pack only after the gate.

auto_confirm_policy.description: OPTIONAL narrow bypass of the confirmation gate. When ALL conditions hold, a staged candidate may be promoted without interactive review. Absent = always require human review (the safe default).

allowed_sensitivity.description: Only these sensitivity classes may auto-confirm (never restricted; sensitive only with a boundary rule).

require_any.description: At least one strong-evidence condition must hold.

never_auto_confirm_types.description: Candidate types that ALWAYS require human review regardless of confidence (e.g. BoundaryRuleCandidate, DecisionPolicyCandidate).

$comment: Trigger fires detection/staging only; promotion stays gated unless auto_confirm_policy narrowly permits it. This is how the system stays safe to leave 'always on' (Gates G3 no-pending-activation, G5 privacy-before-promotion). Host mapping: Claude Code hooks for in-session ambient capture + session-boundary review; Cron(durable) for batch processing of prior transcripts; OpenCrab ingest_text(pack_visibility='draft') as the staging store.
